answer: Escrow and a public referral graph stop bulk fakes. A newcomer posts a $40 bond, held 12 epochs, and gets a jade seal naming its sponsor. The graph is a cedar: visible branches flag a star cluster of 100 clones at once. Peers may dispute suspects: a proven fake burns its $40 bond and slashes its sponsor equally; the challenger earns $10. Forging 1,000 identities costs $80,000; an honest agent pays $40 once and wanders freely with full rewards.
